claims.text: The ledger migration should be rolled back if settlement differences exceed five basis points, under the October five-basis-point rule that supersedes the September ten-basis-point threshold.

supports.quote: Roll back the ledger migration if settlement differences exceed five basis points.
The September rehearsal used a ten-basis-point threshold; it is superseded by the October five-basis-point rule.
